viber.help: A viber:// link or a phone number

slot_interval_minutes.label: Slot interval
slot_interval_minutes.help: Booking start times are offered at this step, e.g. 15 min: 10:00 AM, 10:15 AM.
slot_interval_minutes.impact: Applies to new bookings from now; existing bookings keep their times

advance_window_days.label: Advance window
advance_window_days.help: How many days ahead customers and staff can book. 0 = today only.
advance_window_days.impact: Applies to new bookings from now; existing bookings stay, even outside the new window.

transport_fee_amount.label: Home-service transport fee
transport_fee_amount.help: Charged to the customer on each home-service visit. 0 = the shop pays.
transport_fee_amount.impact: Applies to new home-service bookings and visits from now; existing bookings keep their transport fee.

travel_minutes.label: Home-service travel time
travel_minutes.help: Blocks the barber this long before and after a home-service visit, for travel.

tax_enabled.label: Tax
tax_enabled.help: Adds tax to sales. Stays off until tax calculation is added.

service_charge_enabled.label: Service charge
service_charge_enabled.help: Adds a service charge to sales. Stays off until its calculation is added.

printer_width_mm.label: Receipt printer width
printer_width_mm.help: Paper width of the branch's receipt printer.

auto_print.label: Print receipts automatically
auto_print.help: Prints the receipt after Finish on an Android phone with a printer.

thank_you_text.label: Thank-you text on receipts
thank_you_text.help: Printed at the bottom of every receipt.

thank_you.helper: Only the English text is printed on receipts. Leave English empty for no line.

cash_difference_tolerance_amount.label: Cash difference tolerance
cash_difference_tolerance_amount.help: At day closing, a cash difference above this is flagged and the admin is notified. 0 = any difference.
cash_difference_tolerance_amount.impact: Applies to closings from now; closed days keep their result.

show_own_earnings_all.label: Show barbers their own earnings
show_own_earnings_all.help: Each barber sees only their own sales and commission estimate. A per-barber setting overrides this.

default_language.label: Default language
default_language.help: Used for staff who haven't chosen a language, and for their sign-in code e-mails.

upload_max_mb.label: Upload size limit
upload_max_mb.help: Largest file staff can upload, 1–10 MB.

maintenance.label: Maintenance mode
maintenance.help: Shown here only. Turn it on or off on its own screen.
